en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a rural scene with a woman in traditional dress filling metal jugs at an outdoor water source. In the background stands a two‑story plastered house with small windows, chimneys on the roof, and a wooden balcony extension. The caption at the top is in French and English, identifying the setting as Salonique and describing the villager fetching water. A small website watermark appears at the bottom.
